# Expected values: follow-up BigQuery answers from unverified/trunc.txt.
# BigQuery's early zero results differ from GoogleSQL, but zero and nonfinite
# inputs are preserved.

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, -308)) FROM UNNEST([-1.0]) x
=> "0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, -309)) FROM UNNEST([-1.0]) x
=> "0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, -9223372036854775808)) FROM UNNEST([-1.0]) x
=> "0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, -309)) FROM UNNEST([CAST('-0.0' AS FLOAT64)]) x
=> "-0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, -9223372036854775808)) FROM UNNEST([CAST('-0.0' AS FLOAT64)]) x
=> "-0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, -9223372036854775808)) FROM UNNEST([CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64)]) x
=> "-inf"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, -309)) FROM UNNEST([-1.7976931348623157e308]) x
=> "0.0"

# BigQuery answers for ordinary precisions, including the early-exit boundary.
SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, -1)) FROM UNNEST([-1.0]) x
=> "0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, 1)) FROM UNNEST([-1e-100]) x
=> "0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, 0)) FROM UNNEST([-0.1]) x
=> "-0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, 1)) FROM UNNEST([-0.01]) x
=> "0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, 1)) FROM UNNEST([-0.0625]) x
=> "-0.0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', TRUNC(x, 1)) FROM UNNEST([-0.03125]) x
=> "-0.0"
